import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/inputs')
from codec import canonicalize_url as f

x = "a b"
once = f(x)
twice = f(once)
assert once != twice
assert len(x) <= 32 and len(x) > 0
assert all(c.isalpha() or c==' ' or c=='%' for c in x)

obj = {"input": x, "once": once, "twice": twice}
with open('/work/counterexample.json','w') as fh:
    json.dump(obj, fh)
print(open('/work/counterexample.json').read())
